moves.source: Turning the Medusa device back on its makers.

moves.name: Perseus Launch
moves.effect: The user's Guard and Will drop by 1.
moves.source: The rocket the Kingdom of Science builds to reach the moon.

moves.name: Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash
moves.effect: Goes first.
moves.source: The only form he can do, mastered past perfect.

moves.name: Seventh Form: Flaming Thunder God
moves.effect: Goes first. Can't be used twice in a row.
moves.source: The form he made himself, used to defeat Kaigaku.

moves.name: Heroic Flyby
moves.effect: Goes first.
moves.source: Metro City's hero swooping in to save the day, every time.

moves.name: Hextech Gauntlet Punch
moves.effect: Breaks Protect, Light Screen and Reflect before hitting.
moves.source: Her Hextech gauntlets, which punch through walls.

moves.name: Healthcare Scan
moves.effect: Heals the user or an ally by 1/3 of its max Vitality and reveals the target foe's moves.
moves.source: "Hello. I am Baymax, your personal healthcare companion."

moves.name: Rocket Fist
moves.effect: Never misses.
moves.source: The rocket-powered fist Hiro builds into his armour.

moves.name: Freak Quick
moves.effect: Goes first, even before most other quick moves.
moves.source: The eyes-closed quick attack with Kageyama.

moves.name: Water Nebula
moves.effect: Lowers the target's Speed by 1.
moves.source: Two water spirals crushing from both sides.

moves.name: Vorpal Strike
moves.effect: Always a critical hit.
moves.source: The Vorpal Bunny blades that cut through Wezaemon.

moves.name: Vital Instrument: 3R
moves.effect: Double power if an ally fainted last turn.
moves.source: His gloves that turn things he values into weapons.

moves.name: Mother's Rosario
moves.effect: Hits 11 times. Never misses.
moves.source: Yuuki's eleven-hit Original Sword Skill, passed to Asuna.

moves.name: Quagmire
moves.effect: Field for 5 turns: every foe's Speed is halved.
moves.source: The mud spell that stopped a dragon's footing.

moves.name: Stone Cannon
moves.effect: High chance of a critical hit.
moves.source: His spinning rock bullet, the spell he trusts most.

moves.name: Poison Doll
moves.effect: Always causes Bleed. The user loses 1/4 of its max Vitality.
moves.source: His living poison body that comes out for the deadliest fights.

moves.name: Hair Lock
moves.effect: The target can't switch out and its Speed drops by 2.
moves.source: His invisible hair feelers that pin prey in place.

moves.name: Gourmet Cooking
moves.effect: Heals an ally by 1/3 of its max Vitality and raises its Power and Energy by 1.
moves.source: His cooking that can bring out any ingredient's full flavour.

moves.name: Power-Enhancing Kick Shoes
moves.effect: High chance of a critical hit.
moves.source: Agasa's shoes that let a kid kick a ball hard enough to knock out a criminal.
